jobs.description: Data Operations | MotionAnalytics top of page < Back Data Operations Apply Now South District, Israel Job Type Project-Based Workspace Onsite About the Role The Mission To transform real-world human motion into high-quality data assets. Applying as a pair? If you have a friend or study partner you'd like to work with, feel free to mention it in your application! Core Responsibilities As part of the Operations pillar, you and your partner will ensure the integrity of our data pipeline: Field Operations & Recruitment: • Executing video data collection using camera equipment (GoPros) in the field. • Managing subject recruitment: sourcing, scheduling, and coordinating participants. Data Logistics & Integrity: • Ensuring strict file hygiene, organization, and secure data transfer after shoots. • Maintaining detailed exclusion logs and dataset quality notes. Technical Labeling: • Operating internal labeling tools for precise clip tagging and metadata entry. Requirements Team Players: You enjoy collaborating and want to tackle field challenges as part of a duo. Highly Organized: You live by checklists and possess extreme attention to detail. Mobile: Valid driving license and access to a vehicle are required for field site visits. Resourceful Problem-Solver: Proactive, independently solves field challenges. Tech-Comfortable: Tech-savvy and quick to master new hardware and software. About the Company MotionAnalytics is a deep-tech company turning human-motion video into reliable biomechanical intelligence. We build computer vision and machine-learning systems that extract gait signatures and motion analytics from ordinary video. OPS is the team that makes our data real: you collect it, label it, and keep it trustworthy. Apply Now bottom of page
